Definition: adverb from G573 (in the objective sense of G572); bountifully; --liberally.
BiblicalUsage: Haplos means simply, generously, with a single undivided heart, and it appears once. In James 1:5 God gives wisdom to all men liberally, without reproach, and the word for liberally is this one: he gives plainly, freely, and without holding back.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God is not stingy with wisdom, and the only thing standing between me and it is whether I will ask.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
